items.text: If an isolated society developed without contact with major religions, could they develop genuine morality?

options.A: Yes—morality emerges naturally from human social needs
options.B: Yes—they'd discover universal moral truths through reason

items.text: "Morality would exist even if humans didn't"—this statement is:

options.A: False—morality is a human social construction
options.B: Probably false—morality requires moral agents to exist
options.C: Uncertain—depends on whether moral realism is true
options.E: True—moral principles are part of the fabric of reality
